- **Soybean rust**: No match — shows brown/rust-colored pustules, not grayish coating
- **Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus**: No match — shows mosaic/mottling and seed discoloration
- **Soybean_Dwarf_Mosaic_Virus**: No match — shows field-level yellowing and stunting
- **All others**: Show stem/pod/root symptoms or entirely different leaf patterns

The grayish sporulation on the leaf underside with accompanying small yellow spots is the hallmark diagnostic feature of Downy mildew (*Peronospora manshurica*).
